title: The spatulas could FLIP an OSTRICH EGG!
text:
The spatulas could FLIP an OSTRICH EGG!. Dislike the humongous SIZE. Cannot use the large round turner in a standard small frying to flip eggs or grilled cheese as the turner is almost as big as the pan.
Might be useful for a swatter for a gigantic fly!
